box.highlights: Sayville 32, Half Hollow Hills West 0: Patrick Coan completed all nine of his passes for 131 yards and two touchdowns and added 14 carries for 107 yards and a TD to lead host Sayville in a Suffolk III opener. Tristan Vitale rushed for 71 yards and a TD on 12 carries. Luke Neugebauer caught a 52-yard TD pass and Timmy Holahan caught a 5-yard TD pass. Jack Andruszkiewicz had seven tackles, incuding three sacks and three tackles for loss as Sayville held Half Hollow Hills West to 75 total yards of offense.

Sayville 56, Islip 35: Patrick Coan went 7-for-11 with 99 yards and two touchdown passes to lead Sayville (2-0) in Suffolk III. He also rushed 14 times for 140 yards and a score. Timmy Holahan rushed 22 times for 134 yards and two touchdowns. Ben Kloska blocked a punt and Ryan Linker returned it for a 25-yard touchdown.

Sayville 56, Comsewogue 7: Patrick Coan completed 13 passes for 181 yards and two touchdowns and had five carries for 34 yards and two scores to lead visiting Sayville (3-0) in Suffolk III. Colin Darling had nine receptions for 129 yards and two TDs. Tristan Vitale ran for 77 yards and a score and Timmy Holahan added 56 rushing yards and a TD. Luke Neugebauer had an interception. Robert DiFazio scored a 4-yard rushing touchdown for Comsewogue (1-2).

Sayville 61, Hauppauge 14: Patrick Coan completed 14 of 16 passes for 201 yards and 2TDs and had 6 carries for 62 yards and 1TD to lead visiting Sayville (4-0) in Suffolk III. Timmy Holahan had 14 carries for 95 yards and 3 TDs and Luke Neugebauer had 5 receptions for 85 yards and 1 TD. Liam O'Connor had 11 carries for 153 yards and 2 TDs for Hauppauge (1-3).
Patrick Coan completed 11 of 20 passes for 190 yards and a TD and had 21 carries for 106 yards and three TDs for Sayville in Suffolk III.

Sayville 42, Westhampton 14: Patrick Coan completed 19 of 25 passes for 254 yards and three touchdowns and rushed seven times for 64 yards and a TD to lead host Sayville (6-0) in Suffolk III. Timmy Holahan had eight carries for 104 yards and a TD. Colin Darling had eight receptions for 63 yards and a TD and Jake Arato caught four passes for 71 yards and a score. Gabe Bethea caught a 47-yard TD pass and Frankie Hanley added a TD run. Connor Ragimierski ran for touchdowns of 78 and 40 yards for Westhampton (2-4).

Sayville 28, East Hampton 14: Patrick Coan completed 13 of 22 passes for 281 yards and 3 TDs as Sayville (7-0) remained undefeated in Suffolk III. Neugebauer had 8 receptions for 184 yards and 2 TDs. Jackson Carney had a 75-yard kickoff return for a TD for East Hampton (4-3).
Sayville 27, West Islip 24: Patrick Coan threw three touchdowns and had a rushing score for Sayville (8-0) in Suffolk III.

Sayville 41, Westhampton 21: Patrick Coan completed 7 of 10 passes for 141 yards and three touchdowns and added nine carries for 124 yards and a TD to lead host No. 1 Sayville over No. 8 Westhampton in the Suffolk III quarterfinals. Luke Neugebauer caught five passes for 135 yards and three TDs. Timmy Holahan rushed 15 times for 92 yards and a TD and Tristan Vitale had 10 carries for 78 yards and a score. Robert Hoss had two interceptions and six tackles. Sayville (9-0) will host No. 6 East Hampton/Bridgehampton in the semifinals at 4 p.m. on Friday. 
Nick Logelfo caught TD passes of 26, 44 and 70 yards from Pat Fay for Westhampton, which finished 2-7.

Sayville 28, East Hampton/Bridgehampton 14: Timmy Holahan ran 19 times for 148 yards and two TDs, leading No. 1 Sayville to a home win over No. 4 East Hampton/Bridgehampton in the Suffolk Division III semifinals. Patrick Coan added 17 carries for 117 yards and completed 3 of 12 passes for 92 yards and a TD. Tristan Vitale rushed for 70 yards and a TD on 14 carries and added two catches for 78 yards and a score. Robert Hoss led the Golden Flashes with eight tackles and an INT. Theo Ball threw touchdown passes of 81 and 52 yards to Jai Feaster and Livs Kuplins, respectively, for East Hampton/Bridgehampton (6-4). Sayville (10-0) will face No. 2 Smithtown West in the Suffolk Division III championship game Thursday at 4 p.m. at Stony Brook University.

Top-seeded Sayville defeated No. 2 Smithtown West in the Suffolk III final at Stony Brook University. Sayville (11-0) will face the winner of Wantagh/Bethpage in the LIC at 4:30 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 28 at Hofstra.
Sayville (12-0) defeats Wantagh for the Long Island Class III title. It's their eighth LIC and first since 2022.
